environment_label: compose (emulators), bounded feasibility only - not capacity evidence (G12)
method: locust headless (isolated uv env, locust pinned in requirements.txt); API = local uvicorn (1 worker) from neurosphere_api.main:create with the ingest edge; sink = Event Hubs emulator from docker compose; synthetic events only; latency is per POST (a batch of events)

profile_definition.note: Provisional planning targets from the PRD, measured not guaranteed. The p95 bound has no ingest-specific PRD figure; it reuses the 2 s dashboard planning target as a placeholder.

environment_notes.api: local uvicorn process, 1 worker, NS_ENV=local (not the compose api container: it has no ingest producers configured)
environment_notes.sink: Event Hubs emulator (docker compose), hub 'telemetry', 4 partitions
environment_notes.edge_limiter: product defaults (20 rps per producer, burst 40)

documented: Event Hubs emulator: one namespace, ten hubs, no persistence, SAS only (no Entra); partition and consumer-group scale cannot be inferred from it.
Cosmos DB vNext emulator: no RU accounting, so no request-unit capacity is measured.
observed_in_this_run: Achieved 240.32 accepted events/s against a 1000.0 events/s target on one single-worker local API and one Event Hubs emulator (a ceiling of this setup, not of the product).
Errors observed (count by type): no_response_connection_or_timeout=44. 503 is the edge's retryable dependency error (emulator publish failure); 429 is the per-producer edge limiter.
Not observable on the emulator: persistence across restart, partition-count and consumer-group scale, RU accounting, Entra auth.

API log error lines (top 3): 1x Exception in callback _ProactorBasePipeTransport._call_connection_lost(None); 1x ConnectionResetError: [WinError 10054] An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host

open: G07 stays OPEN: this run is bounded feasibility on emulators, not capacity evidence.
